workspace_policy.derivation: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 200000 iterations, session-bound salt as established in the prior EP protected-volume design

notes: BitLocker is mandatory for the complete workspace at every location, including CECEQ.
The operator enters the same master passphrase used for the canonical environment-variable vault; the existing per-session derivation is retained.
At CECEQ automatic cleanup closes the session, purges ephemeral secrets, locks BitLocker and dismounts the volume, but preserves the encrypted workspace folder/container.
Outside CECEQ automatic cleanup removes only the EP-controlled workspace container and folder after the persistence attempt; confidentiality takes precedence if persistence fails.
Visual Studio Code exit is not a current trigger. Guardian supervision is independent of any IDE.
This policy does not activate Guardian, create scheduled tasks, create the workspace, or change Windows files.
The fila4 Desktop path remains unresolved due to conflicting registry values; no workspace folder is materialized until resolved.
